purpose: Reversible unassigned artistic limestone material pilot for flat wall and paving review
sourceAuthority: IAA historical limestone analogue; no claim of exact Third Temple quarry or finish
geometryPolicy: No geometry, collision, source mesh, existing material, map assignment or map save changes
rights: Original procedural shader only; no third-party imagery
dimensionsStatus: All block spacing and grain periods are artistic design choices in centimeters, not measured Yechezkel masonry courses or geological data
mapping: World-space dominant-axis projection; bounded flat axis-aligned surfaces only. Sloping and curved transitions are unaccepted.
behavior: Small seeded block tint and value shifts, broad dressed-face variation, derivative-faded fine grain in color/roughness/world normal. No cracks, grime, moss, simulated grout recess or displacement.
limits: Periodic analytical grain is a low-cost pilot, not a scanned limestone surface; reject if its pattern is visible.
No automatic material assignment or map save. Root must checkpoint, temporarily assign a bounded patch, compare and restore.
Do not assign to source-blue Ulam or other distinct material classes indiscriminately.
Shader recompilation request and asset save do not prove shader or visual acceptance.
No performance budget or texture-memory benefit has been measured. No texture resources are introduced.

acceptance.passCriteria: Matched fixed exposure, readable relief without clipping, no visible repeat pattern or seams, no crawling grain during walking/turning, no new streaming or frame-time regression. Artistic palette must visibly improve the current scene before adoption.
